name: Invites
author: OwnPBX
description: Invite people to the PBX with a link to copy or an e-mail. A link is for one person or reusable (up to a number of uses), runs out after the days you choose, and makes a normal user or a guest with the guest rules you pick. The person chooses a user name and password and gets an extension that works at once.
